newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai securities crimes drop sharply - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai securities crimes drop sharply - newspaper.

text.p: The number of securities industry-related crimes prosecuted in Shanghai fell to one case in the first quarter of 1997, down from 13 cases during the same period in 1996, the official Shanghai Securities News said on Sunday.
The newspaper said the case involved two people who used funds for speculation, but gave no details.
Shanghai's local procuratorial bodies attributed the sharp drop in securities-related crimes to better methods of publicising the rules and improved enforcement, it said.
China's National People's Congress (parliament) in March passed an amended criminal law which introduced harsh new penalties for securities crimes.
